proposed.text: What is the passing standard for the Architect Licensure Examination as specified in RA 9266, Section 15?

options.text: 60% weighted average, which is below the minimum passing requirement and indicates a need for further study
70% weighted average with no subject below 50%
75% weighted average, which is the standard benchmark for passing and reflects a comprehensive understanding of the material
50% weighted average, a threshold that is not applicable to professional licensure exams due to the need for higher competency

rationale.a: Understates the minimum threshold; RA 9266 Section 15 requires 70%, not 60%.
rationale.c: Overstates the requirement; the law specifies 70%, not 75%.
rationale.d: Confuses the individual subject minimum (50%) with the overall passing standard; the weighted average must reach 70%.
rationale.correct: RA 9266 Section 15 mandates a 70% weighted average across all subjects AND no individual subject may score below 50%, creating a dual-threshold safety standard.
rationale.takeaway: ALE passing: 70% weighted average AND no subject below 50% — both conditions required.
